headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: GAS (9)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Chinese Grand Prix from pole position, 13.8s ahead of Lando Norris, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P18 to P9.
Lance Stroll had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised SAR (10 second time penalty), STR (10 second time penalty) and MAG (10 second time penalty).
There were 40 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 12 points over Sergio Perez.
